items.hyp: Mokwaledi wa ditatofatso tsa boeteledipele mo kwa Frere Hospital mo kapa ya Borwa, Dr David Stead, o tlhoka go tlhoka go tswa go tswa go tswang mo go nna le ditlhopho tsa go tswang mo dikgong tsa tsa kwa ntle ga dikgong tsa coronavirus mo dikgweding tsa dingwaga di le 10.
items.ref: Moitseanape wa malwetse a a tshelanang kwa Bookelong jwa Frere kwa Kapa Botlhaba, Ngk David Stead,  o tlhagisitse matshwenyego a gore tsweletso ya go nwa notagi kwa mafelong ka nako ya maikhutso a paseka a beke e telele a ka oketsa  ditshwaetso  tsa Khorona mo dibekeng tse di tlang.

items.hyp: Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa o tlhageletse ka nako e e fetileng gore go tsaya go tswa mo mafelong a go tswa mo go tswang mo kgweding e e fetileng go tswang mo kgweding e e fetile mme go tlhagelela go tswalwa mo mafelong a go tswalwa mo kgwedinong ya batho, mo barwa le mo kwa ntle ga batho.
